services.desc: Our learning ladder consists of a series of group formats to support learning at all levels - from novice to racer. Courses are led by ECR Pros and focus on different aspects of the sport to develop your driving, your racing, or dig deep into developing specific skills. Learn to drive your car at the limit on a world-class, FIA spec, Race Track. Five Action-packed Sessions on Track and classroom reviews. Lead Follow, Braking, and Car Control Drills. You’ll discover what you and your car are capable of. Half-day of supervised practice with shared pro coaching. REP is for SOLO approved drivers graduating from our IPD Blue level.
